title: AI workspace launch film — scattered tools, a promise with a cycling verb, the product board, meeting notes, answers with sources, agents at work, logo wall and stats

source.author: @moritzkremb
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after a Notion launch film made with Opus 5.5; structure and pacing follow it. Every brand is replaced: the mark, the app icons (generic glyphs, no real logos), the workspace, the customer logo wall (made-up names) and all numbers are fictional placeholders.

scenes: dark: 'Docs here. Chats there. Tasks everywhere.' while app tiles pop in around the text, then everything collapses into a dot
a light disc opens around the logo; 'Where teams and agents • Think/Build/Ship together.' with two doodle avatars
the camera pans to 'The AI workspace that works for you.' and the product board rises and fills the frame; agents move two cards
'Bring everything into one system of record.' next to a meetings database, a recording pill and a 'Notes captured' chip
a question is typed, the answer assembles as a donut, bar and line chart with source chips; 'Get answers, instantly. With citations.'
an agent page and a task board: the agent works, updates five pages and takes a ticket; '24/7 — Keep work moving with agents.'
dark slide: 'Build agents that …' cycling through four uses with a progress track
'Trusted by teams that ship.' with a 5x3 wall of customer names and three counting stat cards
end card: mark and wordmark, tagline, a button the cursor clicks, domain
notes: The board (COLS), the meetings table (ROWS), the chart numbers, the agent's reply and the task cards are data arrays in the script; the mark is the MARK() SVG. Stats are 'value | label' and count up from zero, keeping any prefix or suffix. The customer names are made up: replace them with real customers only if you have permission to show their names, and replace the stats with real numbers or remove the slide.
